title: Investment Performance of Private Pension Plans: Defined Benefit vs. Defined Contribution
eligible_reason: No DiD. The paper compares defined-benefit and defined-contribution plans: reghdfe performance (alpha, Sharpe ratio, returns, expenses, termination) on DC, size, DC x size, size^2 and plan/sponsor controls with time-period, sponsor or sponsor-by-time FE. DC is a fixed plan type, not a treatment switching on over time; remaining tables are factor regressions by size decile and Fama-MacBeth.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe, aweights by number of returns, multiway clustering (start_year end_year sch_h_ein). Form 5500 plan-year panel 1990-2018.
data_files_note: Form 5500 public data shipped; Compustat/CRSP/Bloomberg-derived files included for the Data Editor and flagged for removal from the published package.
screener_notes: Abstract from OpenAlex frame; no article text.
